summary: Tested per-user editing rights (diritti) on backend and frontend, plus the ritenute d'acconto work that hadn't been checked yet. Backend: 18/19 new pytest tests pass. They cover the default rights in /auth/me and /users, PUT /users/{id}/diritti (admin only, also tested with a real admin login), PUT /company (403 / only banche / only dati_azienda / admin), contabilita tables (operatore with the right can create, edit and delete causali and codici IVA; contabile without the right gets 403 on causali and parametri; registrazioni stays contabile-only), articles and magazzino (GET allowed, writes 403 without the right), comunicazioni/config testi rules, and the ritenute flow: supplier with soggetto_ritenuta -> uploaded invoice gets ritenuta 94.25 and netto 480.68; a partial payment gives a proportional ritenuta in /ritenute/mese; da-versare; F24 PDF; versato creates the coge entry (dare 13.03.002 / avere 06.01.001) and annulla removes it. The 1 failure is a 1-cent rounding bug in the ritenute. Frontend: every visibility and redirect rule for users op/opban/optab works, a banche-only user can save banks, admin Settings shows all 7 cards and saves, the Diritti dialog saves and the change persists, and the /ritenute page, dashboard panel, F24 versato UI, PassiveDetail ritenuta card and PartyDialog assoggettamento all work. All TEST data was cleaned up.

minor.issue: The ritenuta share is rounded separately for each payment. Paying an invoice with ritenuta 94.25 in two 50% instalments (240.34 + 240.34) gives 47.12 + 47.12 = 94.24. The F24 total and the versamento entry are then 1 cent less than the 94.25 credited to ritenute_operate when the invoice was registered, so 0.01 stays open in the Erario c/ritenute account. Fix: give the last payment that settles the invoice (or the running total) whatever is left of ritenuta_importo, instead of rounding each payment on its own.

Fields are rebuilt with cur.get(k). Any Company field missing from the stored document is written as null instead of its model default (for example cassa_tipo becomes null instead of an empty string). Use body defaults when cur has no value.
A future versamento date is accepted. The UI fills in the scadenza date (16/11), which is after today (10/11), so a payment that hasn't happened yet is recorded as done and posted to the books.

issues: The month picker is a native input type=month. It shows English labels ('October 2026') in an Italian app; use a localized shadcn-style picker.
After the month is marked versato, the 'RITENUTE DA VERSARE' KPI still shows 94,25 €. Consider relabelling it or showing 0 / 'versato'.

The Professionista column shows the supplier name from the XML ('DEMO Energia Toscana SpA'), while the anagrafica and the coge entry use the party name ('TEST_T42 Studio Legale'). The naming is inconsistent.
Uses native <select> elements (Tipo ritenuta, Causale, Cassa) instead of the shadcn Select used elsewhere.
The header still says 'Cedente / Prestatore · Dati azienda' and the toast says 'Dati azienda salvati' when only the banks card is visible. Minor wording issue.

action_items: Fix the ritenute rounding so that full payment in several instalments adds up to exactly ritenuta_importo (currently 94.24 vs 94.25)
PUT /company with only banche: use model defaults instead of null for fields missing from the stored company
Optional: reject or warn on a future versato date for ritenute and F24; localize the /ritenute month picker
Update the stale test tests/test_iteration23_user_moduli.py: its expected moduli dicts don't include the 'contabilita' key (4 failures there; no regression in the code)
critical_code_review_comments: server.py is 3818 lines. Rights, ritenute and F24 logic should be split into modules (as was done for comunicazioni and contabilita).

diritto_for relies on menu_for() == 'piano-conti' as a fallback for any non-GET contabilita path not listed in _COGE. A future write endpoint under /contabilita (for example an export) would wrongly require tabelle_contabili. An explicit whitelist (conti, causali, codici-iva, parametri) would be safer.
DELETE /magazzino/movimenti still requires tenant_accounting, so an operatore with articoli_magazzino can add stock movements but not delete them. Check whether that is intended.
Rights are enforced both server-side (tenant()) and client-side (Layout nav filter plus redirect in the dirittoFor route guard). Consistent.
seed_data_creation: TEST_T42 company (P.IVA 88123456421) and test-user-t42-* users/sessions were created through mongosh and the API. All were deleted afterwards (verified 0 left). No seeded or real data was changed. The real admin login was used only to call PUT diritti on a TEST user.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Run: pytest tests/test_iteration42_diritti_ritenute.py -n 0. UI setup: python tests/t42_ui_setup.py setup|clean. Tokens test_session_t42_<op|opban|optab|admin> go in the 'session_token' cookie, and localStorage fe_company_id holds the cid. The only remaining failure is test_full_payment_equals_ritenuta (rounding). The previous-month invoice fixture is tests/fixtures/sample_fattura.xml (imponibile 471.25, totale 574.93).
rca of the issue: _ritenute_mesi computes quota = round(ritenuta_importo * min(pagato/netto, 1), 2) for each payment. 94.25 * 0.5 = 47.125, which rounds to 47.12 twice, so 1 cent is lost. Mitigation: track the ritenuta already allocated for each invoice and give the payment that brings cumulative payments to >= netto the remainder (ritenuta_importo - allocated).
